results.title: Mapping the terraces on the Loess Plateau based on a deep learning-based model at 1.89 m resolution | Scientific Data
results.content: Terraces on the Loess Plateau play essential roles in soil conservation, as well as agricultural productivity in this region. However, due to the unavailability of high-resolution (<10 m) maps of terrace distribution for this area, current research on these terraces is limited to specific regions. We developed a deep learning-based terrace extraction model (DLTEM) using texture features of the terraces, which have not previously been applied regionally. The model utilizes the UNet++ deep learning network as its framework, with high-resolution satellite images, a digital elevation model, and GlobeLand30 as the interpreted data and topography and vegetation correction data sources, respectively, and incorporates manual correction to produce a 1.89 m spatial resolution terrace distribution map for the Loess Plateau (TDMLP). However, due to the lack of a high-resolution (<10 m) terrace distribution map for the Loess Plateau (TDMLP), current research has been limited to specific areas10."), and research on the Loess Plateau has not yet been studied comprehensively.
